title: Lawsuit Against OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Dismissed
excerpt: A US judge has dismissed a sexual abuse lawsuit filed against OpenAI CEO Sam Altman by his sister, Ann Altman.
body_html:
A federal judge has dismissed a lawsuit that was filed last year against OpenAI CEO Sam Altman by his sister, Ann Altman. The complaint contained allegations that the OpenAI chief executive had sexually abused her during their childhood.

According to the ruling issued by US District Judge Zachary Bluestone, the case was thrown out because the plaintiff failed to attend a scheduled independent medical examination over the past year. The dismissal brings an end to the legal action that had previously drawn public attention following initial reports by media outlets.
